plugins.name: vulnary
plugins.description: Vulnerability intelligence from OSV.dev and NVD. Look up a CVE by ID for its description, severity, CVSS score and references; check a package version for known vulnerabilities across npm, PyPI, crates.io, Go, Maven, RubyGems and NuGet; batch-check a dependency list; or scan a package.json or requirements.txt and get the fixed-in version for every vulnerable package.
